research_scope: Change The Future — Ki Blast Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.identity_note: Repository commit history contained no prior Change The Future research batch.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Change The Future as a Ki Blast Super and Counter Skill. The counter is triggered by basic Ki Blasts or Ki Blast skills despite the in-game description incorrectly referring to Strike attacks.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Parallel Quest 43 — Change the Future is the documented acquisition route.
verification_audit.finish_finding: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide explicitly lists Change The Future under PQ43 Basic Reward, so an Ultimate Finish is not required.
verification_audit.cost_finding: The skill reference lists 100 Ki. No reliable reviewed source establishes a stamina cost or drop probability, so those fields remain null.
verification_audit.availability_finding: The Future Warrior is documented as an obtainable user through PQ43, supporting usable_by_cac true.

records.name: Change The Future
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Change The Future under PQ43 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Take a counter stance against incoming Ki attacks; when struck, move to the opponent and fire a Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: The current Xenoverse 2 skill reference documents the trigger as basic Ki Blasts or Ki Blast skills, with invulnerability during the movement portion. It also notes that the blast does not break guard or hyper armor in the same way as Shadow Crusher. The in-game description's reference to Strike attacks is preserved as a documented description error rather than treated as the actual counter type.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ43 is the documented Future Warrior route and the skill is a Basic Reward. No unsupported drop probability is recorded.
records.pve_notes: The skill can counter Ki Blast pressure and is documented as a PQ43 Basic Reward.
records.pvp_notes: Its intended counter target is Ki Blast attacks. Exact frame and matchup behavior is version-sensitive and is not expanded beyond the reviewed evidence.
